description: Unit test module for server prompts functionality within the openbb_mcp_server project. Contains test cases verifying loading, validation, and execution behaviors of prompt definitions, including handling invalid prompts and argument defaults.

classes.name: test_load_prompts_from_json
classes.description: Test loading prompts from a JSON file and adding them to the MCP server.

classes.name: test_skip_invalid_prompts
classes.description: Test handling of invalid prompt definitions with missing or invalid fields and logging of errors.

classes.name: test_skip_invalid_arguments_in_prompts
classes.description: Test handling of invalid argument definitions within prompts and logging errors appropriately.

classes.name: test_execute_prompt_tool
classes.description: Test execution of prompt tools, including argument substitution and default handling.

methods.name: test_load_prompts_from_json( mock_from_fastapi, mock_tool_registry, mock_process_routes, tmp_path )
methods.description: Tests loading and adding prompts from a JSON file into the MCP server.

methods.name: test_skip_invalid_prompts( mock_from_fastapi, mock_tool_registry, mock_process_routes, mock_logger, tmp_path, )
methods.description: Tests that invalid prompt definitions are skipped with error logs.

methods.name: test_skip_invalid_arguments_in_prompts( mock_from_fastapi, mock_tool_registry, mock_process_routes, mock_logger, tmp_path, )
methods.description: Tests skipping prompts with invalid argument definitions and logs errors.

methods.name: test_execute_prompt_tool( mock_from_fastapi, mock_tool_registry, mock_process_routes, tmp_path )
methods.description: Checks the functionality of executing a prompt with arguments, including defaults.
